**Finding submitted: INDEMN — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Investigation:** The only indemnity language in the Agreement is the reciprocal consortium indemnity at 21.2 (p0241), limited to third-party claims against a Party *as an owner of APCN 2* and share-capped under Schedule B. Paragraph 32 (p0275–p0280) is claims-settlement/cost-sharing machinery, not an indemnity in our favour; 21.1/21.3 limit liability; 4.9 and its sub-items disclaim any warranty as to the Supplier or Wet Segment. Searches for "indemnify", "patent", "intellectual property", "Supplier" and "liability" surfaced no IP-infringement or misconduct indemnity anywhere.
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback on a material term (no Vendor IP indemnity at all — walk-away territory), so a redline is warranted.
- **Cure:** One inserted Subparagraph 21.4 at the end of Paragraph 21 carrying exactly the seven fallback elements — IP indemnity in Teleglobe's favour, modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace remedies, fee refund if unavailable, and a 3× annual fees super-cap. Preferred was not targeted because narrowing our own side of the mutual 21.2 indemnity and adding a full defence/procedure regime would require collateral rewrites of the consortium structure.
